name: Plugin Store
author: Vestra Player
description: Browse plugins from the official Vestra Player plugin repository: descriptions, changelogs, version history and the permissions they need. Install, update or uninstall in one click; add third-party repositories (clearly marked as unofficial), install from a link or a local .vxp file, or drop a .vxp file on the video area. The official repository's index is digitally signed, and the store checks the signature and every package's checksum; versions revoked by a repository are disabled, with the reason.
